item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
Changed

  • ADSwift is faster. Moving between apps, campaigns, ad groups, and keywords — and opening tables and the detail panel — is noticeably quicker and smoother.
  • A refreshed look. Cleaner typography, softer panels, and more refined status colors give the app a more polished feel.

Removed

  • The in-app AI chat has been removed. It’s replaced by the ADSwift CLI — a more powerful way to manage your campaigns from the terminal that works with any AI agent or coding assistant.

Improved

  • A more dependable command-line tool. The adswift CLI installs more reliably, and its doctor command now pinpoints common setup problems — like running from a temporary copy or a missing PATH entry — so it works the first time.
